name: root-crate-load-ingest-split
body: Wave D of the multi-wave task-19 decomposition (no behaviour change). src/load.rs is decomposed into load/{parquet,tables,export} — nothing stays in load/mod.rs. src/ingest.rs is decomposed into ingest/{identity,blacklist,render,edges}. The ingest CORE deliberately STAYS in ingest/mod.rs (ingest_records, claim, ingest, opt, spec_node, insert_node, finalize_graph, IngestOptions, Reuse, IngestReport) so its durable spine identities (rust.apg.ingest.ingest_records, rust.apg.ingest.claim) keep resolving; the module FQNs rust.apg.ingest and rust.apg.load are likewise preserved by mod.rs. The 5 implemented-by edges for functions that move are re-pointed to the post-split FQNs; the module-level edges and the two edges targeting core units are left untouched.
